items.author: Amuthan K
items.text: Had a great stay at this hotel. The rooms were clean and well-maintained, and the staff were very polite and helpful throughout. Check-in and check-out were smooth, and the location was convenient for getting around. Overall, a comfortable and pleasant experience—would definitely stay here again.

items.author: ajith bu
items.text: The lodging experience was very comfortable and pleasant. The rooms were clean, well-maintained, and suitable for families. The atmosphere was peaceful, making it a good place to relax after travel.

items.author: Sandhiya Chandrasekar
items.text: Really enjoyed my stay here. The room was neat, comfortable, and exactly as expected. The staff were courteous and quick to assist, making the overall experience smooth. The location is a big plus, with easy access to everything nearby.

Very comfortable stay overall. The room was clean and well kept, and the staff were polite and attentive throughout. Service was prompt, and the location made it easy to get around.

Simple, reliable, and worth the price—would definitely consider staying again
